integrity: Proof reconstructs the two cumulative crossings analytically for every positive squared coefficient of variation; floating-point diagnostics are supplemental, and independent validation is not claimed.
limitations: Idealized unshifted parametric travel-time kernels, not a calibrated flow model. Not a noisy-estimation result. The model family and moments do not establish mechanistic correctness. Potential priority overlap with earlier stochastic-order or reaction-time literature remains.
title: Exactly two arrival-fraction reversals between moment-matched Gamma and inverse-Gaussian residence clocks
